Academic information
Restrictions
All undergraduate areas are available to exchange students
(except Nursing ). Business courses require proof of pre-
requisites for upper division courses. Art-requires program
admission and a portfolio.
Class schedule/Timetable
Class schedules can be found on http://my.boisestate.edu
Please note that schedules are different from catalogs. The
catalog is for course descriptions.  The schedule is what is
offered for the term a student is studying at Boise State. 
Course catalog/registration
Catalogs can be viewed on the Registrar’s website. 
Registration will be through the My.BoiseState.edu system
Nominations should be submitted by March 1 (Fall)
October 1 (Spring) using this form.
https://forms.gle/f72FzucMJMCpCGQb8
Nominated students will then need to apply on-line here:
https://admissions.boisestate.edu/apply/
We reserve a number of housing spaces for exchange
students. If they follow our instructions, generally they can
have a place in on campus housing. Exchange students
typically live in the “Suites”  More information on housing
and costs can be found on the Housing website.
